features.heading: Signals Translated to Intelligence
features.subheading: Everything you need to understand someone's Instagram activity
features.postLikesDesc: See every photo and video they double-tap. Know their tastes instantly.
features.newFollowsDesc: Find out who they start following — friends, exes, or influencers.
features.unfollowsDesc: Know when they quietly unfollow someone. Patterns reveal priorities.
features.reelLikesDesc: Not just posts — we track every Reel they like. Unique in the market.
features.followAnalysisDesc: Spot follow-back games and ghost patterns in real time.
features.activityReportsDesc: Weekly and monthly summaries delivered to your inbox.
features.differentiatorTitle: Not just posts. We track Reels too.
features.differentiatorDesc: Most trackers miss Reels likes entirely. CheaterFinder captures the full picture — giving you insight competitors can't match.
features.differentiatorBullet1: Detect specific niches and content types
features.differentiatorBullet2: Identify patterns across weeks of data

home.heroDesc: Automated reports on any public Instagram account — every like, new follow, and unfollow.
home.heroCtaHint: No Instagram password needed — works on any public account.
home.disclaimer: Not affiliated with Instagram. For personal insight use only.
home.step1Desc: Enter the Instagram usernames included in your package.
home.step2Desc: Our system silently captures their public activity 24/7.
home.step3Desc: Receive an email the moment your report is ready.
home.step4Desc: Log in to see likes, follows, and behavioral trends.
home.dataAvailabilityNotice: Results depend on available Instagram data and may be delayed or incomplete.
home.accessNotice: Private accounts require the owner to accept a visible follow request from a service account. Approval, timing and complete coverage are not guaranteed.

privateAccount.gainingAccessDesc: The owner must accept a follow request from a service account before private activity can be collected. The request is visible to them; acceptance and timing are not guaranteed.
privateAccount.accessDeniedDesc: Private access is unavailable. The owner must accept a service account’s follow request. Retrying may send another visible request; it does not guarantee access.
privateAccount.retryFailed: Access could not be requested. Please try again later.
privateAccount.approvedCollectionPending: Access is approved, but no posts or stories are available yet. Collection can be delayed; this does not mean there is no activity. Check the latest sync status below.
privateAccount.pendingFeedDesc: Private activity can appear after the owner approves a service account’s follow request and collection succeeds. An active paid subscription or Stripe trial is also required.
